title: integrated-flashweave-windowed-kv-and-rope-remat
author: Maya Chen
description: Introduce the "FlashWeave" attention path: a compact FlashAttention-inspired microkernel that fuses rotary/rope rematerialization with a windowed KV prefetch strategy and scheduler hints for continuous batching. Motivation: reduce hot-path allocations and KV cache pressure for long-context streaming workloads while preserving low tail latency for short requests. This PR contains kernel, scheduler, and runtime fallbacks needed to safely deploy the path behind ops flags and model annotations. Key changes are summarized below and in the commit log. Benchmarks and compatibility notes, as well as rollout steps, are included.

benchmarks: Microbench (A100, fp16, sequence=1k): throughput +12% vs baseline flashbridge (continuous batching enabled).
End-to-end p95 latency (streaming, mixed payload, 40 concurrent): -8% tail latency vs baseline path (median improvement ~5%).
KV memory pressure (64k rolling window): -22% resident set size due to windowed prefetch and early eviction hints.
Quality: numerically identical outputs within floating error for standard rotary-enabled models; unit remat tests validate token-level equivalence for 99.99% of cases.
compatibility_notes: Default is opt-in via feature flag 'flashweave_enabled' and model annotation 'attn.path=flashweave'.
Fallback to existing flashbridge path when kernel JIT fails, driver older than CUDA 11.8, or when quantized kernels are selected.
Config knobs expose KV window size, prefetch lookahead, and eviction aggression for per-model tuning.
No changes to REST API surface. Changes are runtime-only and covered by rollout playbook.
rollout_playbook: 1) Enable feature flag in staging for a single canary tenant with low RPS.
2) Monitor token-level latency, KV hit rate, and memory RSS for 24h.
3) Gradually expand to production canaries using priority lanes, watch autoscaler behavior.
4) If p95 regresses >10% for a tenant, flip runtime annotation to fallback and collect traces for investigation.
5) Promote to GA when 72h of stable metrics observed across three regions.
release_notes: Introduce FlashWeave attention path: fused rotary rematerialization and windowed KV prefetcher for improved throughput and reduced KV memory usage. Opt-in behind feature flag and model annotation. See docs/ops/rollout-playbook.md for safe rollout steps.
